details.report: Committed forward as 5e7941e. Native Navigator evidence-tool pages now produce one authoritative typed read record preserving partial=false and paged-complete=true through Recorder live settlement and readSealed; Runner validates that record directly rather than manufacturing complete reads. Compatible lifecycle publication losers reread canonical ledger truth, return an already-completed canonical call result, and fail closed before child launch when the winning transition is still pending. Existing no-replace publication, hash-chain/corruption checks, and lock-free ledger remain unchanged. Added production-seam byte-coverage and replay regression coverage, rebuilt distributions, and passed typecheck plus the unified suite (375 pass, 5 skip, 0 fail).
